You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Rearranging the office seating. A team of five has outgrown the way its desks were originally placed, and the layout is being settled before the floor is reorganized. All five will sit in whatever is decided. Participants: Victoria, May, Minato, Shunichi and Daisuke. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Facilities quote for re-running power and network
- Basis of the department's floor billing
- Morning routine on the pilot floor upstairs
- Unplanned seat shuffles in the past year
- Sound meter readings across the room
- Physio's note from the workstation check
- Drawn plan against the staff survey
- Arrival times in the badge records
- Two project strands within earshot last spring
- What this year's two joiners reported

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Victoria, Minato, May, Shunichi and Daisuke. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the options | 4 turns | every participant votes; the option with the most votes is adopted |
- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied options is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

## Looking into things
After round 1, each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into. What they find out is told only to that participant.

## Participants
Name: Victoria
Age: 37
Gender: female
Personality: Victoria is a calm and rational person, but at times her excessive thoughtfulness can create barriers between her and those around her. She is reserved in her emotional expressions and keenly observes the expressions and attitudes of others, trying to discern their inner thoughts. Because she does not express herself much, she often gives others the impression of being somewhat mysterious, but deep down she has a strong will and a determination to stick to her beliefs. At times, she may display expressions of anxiety or fear, but it is precisely in such moments that her true strength becomes evident.
Concern: The reorganization comes out of the same budget line that has not been raised since the team was half this size. I would rather know what this floor actually costs us, one way and every month, before we commit to a shape for it.

Name: May
Age: 24
Gender: female
Personality: May is a confident, sociable woman with a playful side. She is charming to those around her and often plays the role of entertainer. She understands her own appeal well and knows how to behave appropriately in different situations. She can be a little challenging and sometimes comes across as cold, but she basically has a charisma that attracts people.
Concern: My week is already cut into short gaps between meetings, and anything that eats those gaps costs far more than it looks like on paper. Before a layout is fixed I want to know what it takes out of our days, both while we are changing over and on every ordinary morning after.

Name: Minato
Age: 10
Gender: male
Personality: Minato has a calm personality and likes to interact with people around him in a peaceful manner.
